items.text: Test file, image and oversize cases through create and follow-up. Keep five files per message, 20 MiB per file and 48 KiB chunks. Verify early local rejection, order and digests against shared fixture bytes. Upload failure must not send the referencing message; concurrent or cancelled sends stay isolated.
AttachmentsUITests covers selection, local thumbnail, progress and retry without losing the draft. Run the attachments demo and inspect the resulting task or follow-up.

Exercise shared commands via create, follow-up, approval or question answer, completion, enqueue while running, stop back to draft and continue after failure. Use FollowUpQueueTests, QuestionAnswersTests, ApprovalSheetUITests and RoundTripUITests with their existing demos. The feature layer consumes typed errors instead of constructing wire errors.
The same slice passes scripts/swift-test --package-path ios/DSHKit and scripts/xc build -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator'. Pages exercise platform work through a Core capability.
